# uptimeeye_notification_channel (Data Source)

Looks up an existing notification channel by its exact name. Useful when channels are managed outside of Terraform but need to be referenced by monitors or scheduled tasks.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "uptimeeye_notification_channel" "existing" {
  name = "On-Call"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Display name of the channel to look up. Must match exactly one channel.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Channel identifier.
- `tags` (List of String) Tags for organizing channels.
